quests.title: The Awakening
quests.name: The Awakening
quests.description: You awaken in the Verdant Grove with no memory. The Elder says the Sap has chosen you for a purpose tied to the spreading corruption. Prove yourself by defeating the forest creatures that have turned hostile before the Elder will tell you more.

objectives.description: Defeat Forest Guardians threatening the Grove
Return to the Elder and report what you found

quests.title: The Shadow Threat
quests.name: The Shadow Threat
quests.description: The Elder warns of shadow creatures emerging from the Crystal Caverns, drawn by a pulse of corrupted Sap. Venture inside and discover what stirs in the darkness before it reaches the Canopy of Life.

objectives.description: Enter the Crystal Caverns
Defeat Shadow Stalkers lurking in the caverns
Collect Shadow Essence from defeated stalkers

quests.title: The Crimson Rising
quests.name: The Crimson Rising
quests.description: Crimson Sap energy is surging across the land, twisting the Wardens of the Crimson Plateau into monsters fuelled by raw corruption. They must be stopped before the Crimson phase overwhelms the other two Sap streams permanently.

objectives.description: Reach the Crimson Plateau
Defeat Crimson Wardens empowering the surge
Collect Crimson Shards to analyse the corruption

quests.title: The Nexus Convergence
quests.name: The Nexus Convergence
quests.description: All three Sap streams converge at the Nexus Spire, and the corruption is funnelling toward that focal point. If the Spire falls, the Sap Cycle collapses. Reach it, fight through the wardens still loyal to the corruption, and restore balance.

objectives.description: Enter the Nexus Spire
Defeat the Crimson Wardens guarding the convergence
Activate the Sap Harmoniser at the Spire's heart

quests.title: The Veil Unraveling
quests.name: The Veil Unraveling
quests.description: Cleansing the Nexus Spire reveals a deeper truth: the corruption was only a symptom. A tear in the Veil between worlds is spreading from deep within the Hollowroot Catacombs. The factions must unite, but centuries of rivalry make that nearly impossible.

objectives.description: Consult Seer Althea at the Whispering Veil
Convince Commander Briara to commit Bloomguard forces
Gain Archdruid Veyla's support for the Emerald Coven
Investigate the Veil Echo Chamber firsthand

quests.title: The Siege of Hollowroot
quests.name: The Siege of Hollowroot
quests.description: With the factions rallied behind you, lead a combined assault into the deepest chambers of the Hollowroot Catacombs. The Veil Tear must be sealed before whatever entity lurks beyond breaks through into Verdance.

objectives.description: Lead the coalition into the Deep Hollowroot
Defeat the Veil Horrors guarding the tear
Gather Veil Sealing Reagents from defeated Horrors
Perform the Sealing Ritual at the Veil Tear

quests.title: The Fractured Alliance
quests.name: The Fractured Alliance
quests.description: The seal holds — barely. The Sporecaller Syndicate has been secretly siphoning Sap energy from the tear for their experiments. Confront Sporecaller Mycel and decide the Syndicate's fate. Your choice will shape every faction relationship going forward.

objectives.description: Search the Sporecaller Labs for evidence
Collect Sporecaller Research Logs
Confront Sporecaller Mycel with the evidence
Decide the Syndicate's fate: Exile, Reform, or Alliance

quests.title: The Unbinding
quests.name: The Unbinding
quests.description: The Ancient Unbinding Site has activated. Something vast and ancient stirs beyond the Veil, drawn by the fractured Sap streams across Verdance. Rally all factions at the Everwood Heart for a final stand — or the realm of Nexus will be consumed by what lies beyond.

objectives.description: Rally all four faction leaders at the Everwood Heart
Enter the Everwood Heart
Defeat the Void Herald before it fully manifests
Seal the Veil forever, or absorb the Void's power

quests.title: Gathering Herbs
quests.name: Gathering Herbs
quests.description: Herbalist Tansy is running low on potion ingredients. Corrupted creatures have been raiding the supply stores along Herbalist Row. Help replenish the stock by clearing the creatures and collecting any potions they drop.

objectives.description: Defeat Thorn Sprites near the herb gardens
Collect Minor Health Potions
Return to Herbalist Tansy

quests.title: Sunken Secrets
quests.name: Sunken Secrets
quests.description: Scholar Archivist Scroll has heard rumours of pre-Veil knowledge buried in the Sunken Ruins. Explore the ruins, clear the guardians that have taken up residence, and bring back any lore fragments you find.

objectives.description: Explore the Sunken Ruins
Clear hostile Forest Guardians from the ruins
Recover lore fragments left by the First Keepers

quests.title: Bloomguard Patrol Duty
quests.name: Bloomguard Patrol Duty
quests.description: Commander Briara needs patrols along the Canopy perimeter after corrupted vine creepers began testing the outer walls. Prove your worth to the Bloomguard by clearing the threat and reporting back.

objectives.description: Report to Commander Briara at the Barracks
Clear corrupted vine creepers from the Canopy perimeter
Report back to Commander Briara

quests.title: Corruption in the Ranks
quests.name: Corruption in the Ranks
quests.description: Briara suspects a Bloomguard officer has been compromised by Veil corruption. The signs are subtle — erratic patrols, unexplained equipment thefts. Investigate the barracks at night, follow the trail to the Thornbinder Safehouse, and bring the traitor to justice.

objectives.description: Search the Barracks at night for clues
Follow the corruption trail to the Thornbinder Safehouse
Defeat the Corrupted Officer Varn
Bring evidence to Commander Briara

quests.title: The Rite of Renewal
quests.name: The Rite of Renewal
quests.description: Archdruid Veyla requires rare reagents for the annual Rite of Renewal, a ceremony that rejuvenates the Canopy's root network. Corruption has tainted the usual gathering sites, so the components must be sourced from dangerous territory.

objectives.description: Gather Moonpetal Blossoms from the Emerald Cascades
Collect Pure Rootsap from the Spindlewood Forest
Attend the Rite of Renewal at the Emerald Sanctum

quests.title: The Great Hunt
quests.name: The Great Hunt
quests.description: Beastcaller Yenna invites you to the Wildkin Pact's Great Hunt. The Thornmaw Alpha — a massive corrupted predator — terrorises the Wildkin Hunting Grounds and must be brought down. Track it, weaken it with traps, and make the kill.

objectives.description: Find Thornmaw Alpha tracks in the Hunting Grounds
Set hunting traps at key locations
Defeat the Thornmaw Alpha
Present the trophy to Beastcaller Yenna

quests.title: Volatile Research
quests.name: Volatile Research
quests.description: Sporecaller Mycel offers access to the Syndicate's research in exchange for retrieving volatile Sap samples from the three active corruption zones. The samples destabilise rapidly and must be handled quickly.

objectives.description: Collect a Volatile Blue Sap Sample from Crystal Caverns
Collect a Volatile Crimson Sap Sample from the Plateau
Collect a Volatile Silver Sap Sample from Glinting Groves
Deliver all samples to Sporecaller Mycel

quests.title: The Lost Expedition
quests.name: The Lost Expedition
quests.description: A Bloomguard scouting party went missing in the Hollowroot Catacombs three weeks ago. Guard Captain Reyla asks you to find survivors and recover their mission report before the catacombs swallow the evidence entirely.

objectives.description: Enter the Hollowroot Catacombs
Locate survivors of the lost expedition
Recover the Expedition Leader's Journal
Clear Catacomb Crawlers blocking the exit route

quests.title: Relics of the First Keepers
quests.name: Relics of the First Keepers
quests.description: Shadowmaster Kael has identified a First Keeper artifact deep within the Hollowroot Catacombs. The artifact predates the current Sap Cycle and may hold the key to understanding the ancient sealing rituals needed to close the Veil permanently.

objectives.description: Reach the Sealed Chamber in the deep catacombs
Solve the First Keeper's locking mechanism
Defeat the Keeper's Sentinel
Recover the Keeper's Sealing Stone

quests.title: Whispers in the Thicket
quests.name: Whispers in the Thicket
quests.description: Innkeeper Maren's young niece wandered into the Spindlewood Forest three days ago, drawn by strange whispers that only she could hear. The Sap Cycle is making the forest unpredictable; find the child before a predator does.

objectives.description: Search the outer Spindlewood for tracks
Drive off Timber Wolves blocking the search path
Find Maren's niece deep in the thicket
Escort the child safely back to the Canopy of Life

quests.title: The Drowning Light
quests.name: The Drowning Light
quests.description: A water spirit at the Emerald Cascades is trapped in a corrupted eddy, and the pools downstream are turning dark. If the corruption reaches the Canopy's water supply, the Rite of Renewal will be impossible. Solve the water-flow puzzles to free the spirit.

objectives.description: Travel to the Emerald Cascades
Redirect the upper waterflow to cleanse the first pool
Redirect the lower waterflow to cleanse the second pool
Defeat the Corruption Elemental at the source
Free the trapped water spirit

quests.title: Shattered Brilliance
quests.name: Shattered Brilliance
quests.description: The crystals of the Glinting Groves are fracturing under unstable Sap energy, spawning Crystal Wraiths that aggressively defend the area. Smith Garon needs uncorrupted crystal cores to craft the weapons the Bloomguard ordered — and time is running out.

objectives.description: Enter the Glinting Groves
Defeat Crystal Wraiths guarding the cores
Collect Uncorrupted Crystal Cores
Cleanse the corrupted crystal node to stop further fracturing

quests.title: The Spore Lord's Domain
quests.name: The Spore Lord's Domain
quests.description: A massive fungal entity known as the Spore Lord has begun spreading its mycelium beyond the caverns at an alarming rate. The Sporecaller Syndicate insists it is merely defending its territory. Others fear it has been corrupted by the Veil. Someone needs to go in and find out.

objectives.description: Enter the Mycelium Nexus
Examine corrupted mycelium growth sites
Defeat Spore Thralls protecting the Spore Lord
Defeat the Spore Lord

quests.title: Shadows of the Past
quests.name: Shadows of the Past
quests.description: Shadowmaster Kael has been tracking Veil anomalies that mirror events from his own buried past. He suspects something in the Whispering Veil has been using his memories against him. Help him face those echoes, and he may finally trust you enough to join your cause.

objectives.description: Speak with Shadowmaster Kael about the anomalies
Investigate the Whispering Veil alongside Kael
Defeat the Shadow Echoes wearing Kael's face
Help Kael confront his past: Forgive or Condemn himself

quests.title: Call of the Wild Heart
quests.name: Call of the Wild Heart
quests.description: Beastcaller Yenna's bonded hawk Skycrest has been captured by poachers operating out of the Spindlewood Forest. Helping her track the poachers and free her companion is the surest way to earn Yenna's loyalty — and gain one of the most capable rangers in Verdance as an ally.

objectives.description: Speak with Beastcaller Yenna about Skycrest
Locate poacher camps in the Spindlewood Forest
Defeat the Poacher Leader and their guards
Free Skycrest from the iron cage

quests.title: The Seer's Burden
quests.name: The Seer's Burden
quests.description: Seer Althea's visions have become overwhelming since the Veil began tearing. Each vision risks fragmenting her mind entirely. Help her stabilise her sight with a dangerous ritual at the Veil Echo Chamber — the dark truths she will see may change everything.

objectives.description: Speak with Seer Althea about her failing visions
Gather Veil-Touched Herbs from the Corruption Quarantine Zone
Escort Althea to the Veil Echo Chamber
Defend Althea from Veil Phantoms during the ritual
Help Althea complete the Stabilisation Ritual

quests.title: The Shattered Mirror
quests.name: The Shattered Mirror
quests.description: Kael's old Veilkeeper order once hid a focus artifact in the Crystal Caverns before they were scattered. The artifact amplifies shadow-based abilities and he believed it lost — until a Shadow Weaver was spotted carrying its signature resonance. Help Kael reclaim what was stolen.

objectives.description: Meet Kael near the Crystal Caverns entrance
Defeat the Shadow Weaver that took the artifact
Recover Kael's Veilkeeper Focus

quests.title: The Hollowed Herd
quests.name: The Hollowed Herd
quests.description: Yenna has found a herd of forest elk near the Spindlewood exhibiting strange, hollow behaviour — they move in silence, their eyes clouded, following a pattern that matches corrupted Veil activity. Investigate the phenomenon with her before the herd turns violent.

objectives.description: Meet Yenna at the herd's last known location
Observe the hollowed elk from a safe distance
Defeat the Vine Wraith controlling the herd
Perform the Wildkin cleansing ritual over the herd

quests.title: The Sight Beyond
quests.name: The Sight Beyond
quests.description: Althea's stabilised visions have begun showing her a place that doesn't exist on any map — a mirror-realm that overlaps the Veil itself. She needs three Resonance Stones scattered across Verdance to triangulate its entry point. This may be the key to stopping the Unbinding.

objectives.description: Speak with Althea about her new visions
Recover Resonance Stones from three Veil-touched sites
Defeat the Crystal Sentinels guarding each stone
Help Althea triangulate the mirror-realm entry point

quests.title: The Commander's Honour
quests.name: The Commander's Honour
quests.description: Commander Briara carries the weight of a battle she believes she lost — the Siege of the East Gate, where her unit was overrun and only she survived. Evidence has surfaced that the defeat was caused by sabotage, not incompetence. Help her find the saboteur and clear her name.

objectives.description: Speak with Commander Briara about the East Gate
Return to the ruins of the East Gate battlefield
Recover physical proof of the sabotage
Confront and defeat the Hollow Knight who carried it out

quests.title: The Root That Remembers
quests.name: The Root That Remembers
quests.description: Archdruid Veyla has discovered that the oldest root in the Verdance — the Worldroot, buried beneath the Everwood Heart — holds memories of the world before the Veil existed. She wants to commune with it, but it has been sleeping since the first Veil tear opened. Help her wake it.

objectives.description: Speak with Archdruid Veyla about the Worldroot
Collect Deep Sap from Ancient Treants in the Everwood
Clear Corrupted Treants blocking the Worldroot chamber
Assist Veyla as she communes with the Worldroot

quests.title: Dust of the Silver Veil
quests.name: Dust of the Silver Veil
quests.description: The Emerald Coven requires Veil Dust for a purification ritual during the next Silver Sap phase. The dust can only be harvested from Veil Wisps that appear in the silver-phase zones, and it disperses quickly once collected. Move fast.

objectives.description: Collect Veil Dust from Veil Wisps in silver-phase zones
Deliver the dust to Archdruid Veyla at the Emerald Sanctum

quests.title: Rot Grub Infestation
quests.name: Rot Grub Infestation
quests.description: Rot Grubs have overrun Merchant Lirel's storage cellar beneath the market district. If they reach the food supplies of Herbalist Row the Canopy could face a shortage. Clear them out before they spread further and report back.

objectives.description: Defeat Rot Grubs in the storage cellar
Report the cellar clear to Merchant Lirel

quests.title: Canopy Stalker Menace
quests.name: Canopy Stalker Menace
quests.description: Hunters returning from Spindlewood report Canopy Stalkers ambushing travellers on the forest road with increasing frequency. The Wildkin Pact will not intervene — the stalkers are not corrupted, just territorial. Someone must thin the pack before a caravan is wiped out.

objectives.description: Defeat Canopy Stalkers in Spindlewood Forest
Destroy the pack's nest to discourage return

quests.title: A Moss Golem's Heart
quests.name: A Moss Golem's Heart
quests.description: Alchemist Ferment needs a Moss Heart — the dense sap-saturated organ at a Moss Golem's core — as the base for a powerful restorative compound. Moss Golems only appear in the deepest grove clearings and do not yield their hearts willingly.

objectives.description: Search the deep groves for a Moss Golem
Obtain a Moss Heart from a Moss Golem
Deliver the Moss Heart to Alchemist Ferment

quests.title: Blight Hound Pack
quests.name: Blight Hound Pack
quests.description: A pack of Blight Hounds has been spotted closing in on the northern approach to the Hollowroot entrance. Left unchecked they will cut off supply lines between the Canopy and the dungeon teams. Eliminate the pack before they grow bolder.

objectives.description: Defeat Blight Hounds near Hollowroot
Locate and seal the pack's den to stop respawning

quests.title: Sap Ghost Banishment
quests.name: Sap Ghost Banishment
quests.description: Sap Ghosts — remnants of travellers who died in corrupted Sap puddles — are draining life from people on the road to the Emerald Sanctum. The Emerald Coven considers them tortured souls that deserve release, not destruction. Either banish them through combat or find their anchors.

objectives.description: Defeat Sap Ghosts haunting the road
Report to Archdruid Veyla

quests.title: Thorn Harrier Clearance
quests.name: Thorn Harrier Clearance
quests.description: Thorn Harriers — fast-moving plant predators with razor-tipped vines — are blocking the northern trail leading to the Wildkin Hunting Grounds. Thin their numbers along the trail so the Wildkin can move their seasonal camp without losses.

objectives.description: Defeat Thorn Harriers on the northern trail
Tell Beastcaller Yenna the trail is clear

quests.title: Trial of the Root Sentinel
quests.name: Trial of the Root Sentinel
quests.description: Wildkin elders speak of a Root Sentinel that guards an ancient seed capable of regenerating a grove destroyed by the Blight. Defeating it in honourable combat is the only way to claim the seed — and to prove yourself worthy of the Wildkin's deepest respect.

objectives.description: Find the Root Sentinel's grove
Defeat the Root Sentinel in honourable combat
Claim the Ancient Seed

quests.title: Veil Watcher's Ritual
quests.name: Veil Watcher's Ritual
quests.description: A lone Veil Watcher — one of the last of the old order — needs ritual herbs to perform a calming ceremony near a thin place in the Veil. If the ceremony is not completed before the next Silver Sap phase, the thin place will expand unpredictably.

objectives.description: Collect Veil-touched Herbs near the thin place
Defeat Thorn Sprites disrupting the ritual site
Deliver herbs to the Veil Watcher

quests.title: Ironbark Smith's Order
quests.name: Ironbark Smith's Order
quests.description: Smith Garon has an urgent commission from the Bloomguard but is out of the rare iron ore that only forms near corrupted mineral veins. The Blight has made the mining sites dangerous, but the pay is worth it.

objectives.description: Defeat Root Crawlers guarding the ore veins
Collect Iron Ore from corrupted mineral veins
Deliver the ore to Ironbark Smith Garon

quests.title: Canopy Scout Recon
quests.name: Canopy Scout Recon
quests.description: Scout Brin needs someone to reach the eastern canopy waypoint and report on Hollow Knight movement patterns spotted from the Bloomguard tower. The route passes through active territory — fast and quiet is better than loud and armoured.

objectives.description: Reach the eastern canopy waypoint
Defeat the Hollow Knight patrol blocking the waypoint
Report movement patterns to Scout Brin

quests.title: Healer Mora's Supplies
quests.name: Healer Mora's Supplies
quests.description: Healer Mora tends to the injured coming out of the dungeon expeditions, but her supply of healing herbs has been depleted by the recent influx of wounded. Gather fresh herbs from the grove before the next patrol group returns.

objectives.description: Collect Healing Herbs from the outer grove
Deliver herbs to Healer Mora

quests.title: Keeper Lynn's Lore
quests.name: Keeper Lynn's Lore
quests.description: Keeper Lynn, the Canopy's archivist, believes a scroll she lost in Hollowroot contains the original Sap Cycle binding formula from before the current Veil tears. Retrieving it could change everything the Coven knows about sealing corruption.

objectives.description: Enter the Hollowroot Catacombs archive section
Defeat Spore Crawlers nesting on the archive shelves
Find the Lost Scroll in the deep archive
Return the scroll to Keeper Lynn

quests.title: Blight Hound Cleanup
quests.name: Blight Hound Cleanup
quests.description: A second Blight Hound pack has been spotted harassing workers at the Sapling Workshop, destroying tools and driving off the apprentices. The Consortium won't pay its crafting quota until it's safe to work — clear the area.

objectives.description: Defeat Blight Hounds near the Sapling Workshop
Report to Consortium Director Orin

quests.title: Sap Weaver's Charm
quests.name: Sap Weaver's Charm
quests.description: The Sap Weaver who lives near the market will craft you a custom Sap Charm if you bring the raw materials. The charm passively amplifies whichever Sap phase is currently active — a small edge that compounds over a long expedition.

objectives.description: Collect Sap Crystals
Collect Moonpetals from the Emerald Cascades
Deliver materials to the Sap Weaver

quests.title: Watcher Cole's Warning
quests.name: Watcher Cole's Warning
quests.description: Watcher Cole reports corrupted movement in the deep woods — not regular blight, but something organised. Investigate what's coordinating the Corrupted Treants and report before whatever is directing them chooses a target.

objectives.description: Investigate the deep woods where movement was spotted
Defeat Corrupted Treants acting as sentries
Locate the corrupted command node directing the treants
Report findings to Watcher Cole

quests.title: Whispers in the Bark
quests.name: Whispers in the Bark
quests.description: The trees near Verdant Heart are dying from the inside — bark turning hollow, sap running black. Elder Thornwick has summoned you. What he knows may be the first true answer to what is happening to the forest.

objectives.description: Speak with Elder Thornwick
Inspect the dying trees (0/3)
Defeat Thorn Sprites feasting on the dying bark

quests.title: The First Hollow
quests.name: The First Hollow
quests.description: Something has corrupted the eastern grove, turning sprites and small creatures into hollow, will-less things that attack anything living. Clear the hollowed creatures and find what they left behind before the corruption spreads further west.

objectives.description: Defeat Hollowed Sprites in the eastern grove
Recover the Veil Shard left at the corruption point

quests.title: The Binding Rite
quests.name: The Binding Rite
quests.description: Veilkeeper Sylara says a ritual can slow the corruption spreading from the first hollow. You need three components: Moonbloom for the binding, Ironbark Shards for the seal, and you must return to Sylara to complete the weaving before the next dawn.

objectives.description: Gather Moonbloom from the Emerald Cascades (0/3)
Collect Ironbark Shards from Corrupted Treants (0/2)
Defeat Corrupted Treants blocking Sylara's path
Return all components to Sylara for the ritual

quests.title: Guardian of the Breach
quests.name: Guardian of the Breach
quests.description: The ritual revealed the corruption's source: a Corrupted Guardian now blocks the Veil breach, empowered by the same hollow energy that has been consuming the grove. It must be defeated before the sealing can even begin. This is what the corruption has been building toward.

objectives.description: Reach the Veil Breach approach
Defeat the Corrupted Guardian

quests.title: Seal the Fracture
quests.name: Seal the Fracture
quests.description: With the Guardian fallen, the Veil breach lies open and vulnerable. The choice of how to seal it is yours: close it permanently using the ancient Binding Rite and cut off the Sap stream that feeds this part of the Verdance, or partially seal it and keep the power flowing at great risk.

objectives.description: Reach the Veil Breach
Defeat Sap Ghosts clustered at the breach
Make your choice at the breach: seal fully or partially
